description: This file contains Python code defining functions and classes for parsing and applying .gitignore style path filters, including regex translation, line parsing, and filter application logic.

classes.name: PathFilter
classes.description: A class for managing and applying path ignore rules based on .gitignore style patterns.

methods.name: fnmatch_translate
methods.description: Translates a shell pattern into a compiled regular expression.

methods.name: parse_line
methods.description: Parses a line from a .gitignore file into a pattern and its properties.

methods.name: PathFilter.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the PathFilter with a root directory and optional extra patterns.

methods.name: PathFilter._read_ignore
methods.description: Reads ignore patterns from a .gitignore file.

methods.name: PathFilter._read_line
methods.description: Parses and stores a single ignore pattern line.

methods.name: PathFilter.__call__
methods.description: Determines if a given path should be included based on ignore rules.
